name: Arcturus CorpSec Spire Detail Dress Uniform
description: Issued exclusively to Arcturus personnel assigned to Tier 4-5 client protection details, the Spire Detail Dress Uniform walks the line between threat-response capability and boardroom acceptability. The jacket is cut from a rigid-weave graphene-threaded fabric that reads as charcoal wool at a glance but offers Level IIA ballistic resistance across the chest and shoulders. Lapels are reinforced with micro-plating; the collar sits high enough to protect the carotid without looking like armor. Arcturus branding is minimal — a small oxidized-silver hex badge at the breast pocket, nothing more. Trousers are articulated at the hip and knee for unrestricted movement, with a magnetic-closure thigh holster channel sewn into the right leg lining. Port access panels at the wrists accommodate standard BCI cuff-links and neural-tether hardware without visible alteration to the silhouette.
cultural_context: Seeing an Arcturus officer in this uniform means someone important is nearby and someone else has paid a great deal to keep them safe. On the Shelf, spotting this uniform triggers immediate behavioral changes in crowds. In the Spire, it is as common as a maitre d's coat.
story_hooks: A secondhand unit surfaces in a Tier 2 pawnshop with all the internal ID tags burned out — someone walked off a detail, or someone took the uniform off a body.
The Arcturus hex badge on one circulating uniform has a faint secondary frequency embedded in the metal that pings a classified location every six hours.
A Spire client insists their Arcturus detail wear the dress uniform at all times, even during a credible threat window, because the armor-visible alternative 'sends the wrong message.'

physical_description.visual_profile: A deceptively civilian-coded security uniform that reads as premium business wear at distance but reveals threat-response architecture up close. Sharp, angular silhouette with controlled aggression in the cut. High collar and structured shoulders suggest both formality and readiness. Minimal branding creates an understated authority — the uniform of someone who doesn't need to advertise their capability.
physical_description.fit: Tailored through the chest and waist with articulated hip and knee construction for unrestricted mobility. Not relaxed, not form-fitting — precisely engineered for rapid weapon access and tactical movement while maintaining boardroom presentation. Slight architectural stiffness in the shoulders from reinforced micro-plating.
physical_description.primary_material: Rigid-weave graphene-threaded synthetic fabric that mimics charcoal wool in appearance but offers Level IIA ballistic resistance. Lapels feature micro-plating reinforcement. High-performance ballistic weave across threat zones.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, dense weave with subtle structural rigidity. Lapels have a faint metallic undertone from integrated micro-plating. Matte finish with no sheen — designed to absorb rather than reflect attention.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal to deep graphite gray with minimal accent. Oxidized-silver hex badge at breast pocket provides only visible branding — deliberately restrained. All closures and reinforcements blend into the fabric.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap closures on jacket front and cuffs for rapid access to integrated hardware. Wrist port panels feature seamless friction-fit design. Thigh holster channel on right leg uses internal magnetic-closure system invisible from exterior.
distinctive_features: High reinforced collar protecting carotid without appearing tactical
Oxidized-silver Arcturus hex badge at breast pocket — sole branding
Articulated hip and knee construction for tactical mobility
Hidden magnetic-closure thigh holster channel in right leg lining
Wrist port access panels for BCI cuff-links and neural-tether hardware
Level IIA ballistic resistance across chest and shoulders
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 corporate security tier disguised as accessible Tier 3-4. The cost and exclusivity mark this as premium, but the deliberate aesthetic restraint avoids corporate ostentation.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by Arcturus CorpSec detail officers protecting high-net-worth individuals in Tier 4-5 client assignments. Signals: vetted professional, armed, well-funded protection detail, and proximity to someone important enough to hire the best. On the Shelf (ungoverned zones), this uniform clears crowds. In the Spire (corpo towers), it's as unremarkable as a maitre d's coat — normalized authority.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to well-maintained. Arcturus officers maintain uniform integrity as part of their professional image. Minor wear patterns emerge around the collar and cuff ports from regular hardware cycling, but overall appearance remains boardroom-ready. No visible patching or distressing.
